item.title: Boris Grebenshchikov, a Russian Rock Musician With a ‘Need to Rebel’
item.description: In the 1980s, Boris Grebenshchikov led a revered Russian underground band. A rereleased documentary from that era is bringing new attention to his work.

item.title: Cash Hidden in Forests? Hungary Goes After Corruption Under Orban
item.description: The new government says $20 million worth of bank notes uncovered in farmhouses and woods are the “tip of the iceberg.” Allies of Viktor Orban, the former prime minister, call it a witch hunt.

item.title: Congo Ebola Outbreak: How Fear and Mistrust Drive Community Spread
item.description: As the Ebola virus spreads in eastern Congo, health teams struggle to curb fatal delays in seeking medical care and the widespread desire to treat sick relatives at home.

item.title: Tracking China’s Intensifying War of Words Against Japan
item.description: Beijing is running a concerted campaign to paint Japan as an aggressor and resurgent military threat, according to a Times analysis.
